slides.texte_overlay:
Weird Habits That Make
People Trust You Instantly

1. Put your phone face-down
when they talk

• It says: you matter
more than my screen.

2. Say "you were right"
out loud

• People remember the man
who can admit it.

3. Say "that's not mine
to share"

• They know their secrets
are safe with you too.

4. Call back the same day

• Reliability is built
in small, boring moments.

5. Ask about something
you don't know

• Curious beats
pretending every time.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. Ask about something
you don't know

• Then I look it up that night
on the Sophia app.
5 minutes, one new idea.
